title: Chapter 6128: Imperious

Chapter 6128: Imperious

Chapter 6128: Imperious

“Can’t get any more imperious than this, the most arrogant soul in Sin.” A listener commented.

“Because he could back it up, this is called ability and capital.” A supporter said: “Whatever he says is the truth.”

“Well, he didn’t kill those cultivators with his power. How is he going to borrow the power of tribulations here?” A big shot said.

“And the previous ones can’t compare to the apex cultivators here. He can’t defeat them alone.” One ancestor added.

“Just watch and see how he’ll kill these apex cultivators.” The supporter had complete confidence.

“It’s difficult.” Those nearby thought that regardless of how devilish Li Qiye was, he wouldn’t be able to muster anything comparable to a tribulation.

Meanwhile, Witch King and the others didn’t take this lightly. They must stop Li Qiye at all costs to prevent interruption. Once Specter Ancestor finished his dao, killing Li Qiye would be easy then.

They exchanged glances and nodded.

“Your insistence is a declaration of war against our dynasty, this will go to the death.” Grand-matron Emperor’s eyes looked like the flames of hell. The wails of specters creeped out listeners.

“Sigh, choosing destruction. Fine, I’ll just destroy your dynasty.” Li Qiye smiled and astounded the crowd with his comment.

“Is that so?” Hoarfrost Emperor approached, looking beautiful and exotic. Being a centaur didn’t diminish her appearance one bit.

“You must get through us first.” She raised two sabers.

“The path of death starts here.” Lightwatch’s voice echoed like a bell.

“It’s happening.” Spectators murmured.

“I wonder what Li Qiye will do.” An emperor opened his eyes wide.

“He can get through these two but there are three more apex emperors. I can’t imagine the method.” A desolate god became curious.

“Choose your weapon.” Hoarfrost said, not attacking an unprepared opponent regardless of his unflattering words.

Chilling breezes emanated from her blades and caught those still standing too close, trapping them in a layer of ice. These were just remnant auras, a direct attack could freeze a kingdom.

“I don’t need weapons for emperors. Just one hand is enough.” Li Qiye said before raising one hand.

Hoarfrost and Lightwatch froze for a second; their eyes narrowed in confusion. One had eleven fruits while the other was at the stately anima level.

Either one could roam the world uncontested yet he made them sound like insignificant beings. Alas, they believed him and became tense.

There was no other way out - only a fight until the very end as Specter Ancestor’s dao protectors.

“Ice World!” Hoarfrost didn’t waste time. The activation of her dao froze weak cultivators in the ghost market.

The slashes overpowered everything in their trajectory. The freezing effect cut powers off at the source, preventing cultivators from harnessing the dao. Top cultivators reverted to helpless mortals.

Lightwatch made his move in unison, swinging his gigantic torch. This was both his weapon and his dao.

“Soulburn Eradication!” He shouted and a nether flame came from the torch, capable of infiltrating any opponent. It reached their true fate and ignited until only ashes were left.

Hoarfrost focused on subduing Li Qiye while Lightwatch performed the killing move. It was a combination of yin and yang with the two opposing affinities.

“What will he do?!” Someone shouted in astonishment, wanting to see Li Qiye’s defensive response. Few could successfully stop this combination attack.

“Can he?” Others doubted his survival chance.
